video_title: Philadelphia 76ers Practice Media Availability 🎙️ | Coach Nurse | 10.07.26

quotes.speaker: Coach Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Nurse on the importance of developing young players' defensive skills
quotes.excerpt: there's a good chunk of really young players that need some long practices and lots of reps
quotes.quote: It's certainly important to get all these guys ready to go and I think that there's a good chunk of really young players that need some long practices and lots of reps, especially on the defensive end. As we see things unfold a little bit and see what these guys' roles are going to be, I almost always can say they need to be knowledgeable of the defensive schemes and be able to make the right rotations. That will get them on the floor and keep them on the floor probably faster than anything.
quotes.social_post: Coach Nurse says young 76ers players need to master defensive schemes and rotations to earn minutes. He notes that defensive reliability will get them on the floor and keep them on the floor probably faster than anything.

quotes.speaker: Coach Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Nurse on the impact of Joel Embiid's injury
quotes.excerpt: it's always a bigger blow for him personally, but certainly a blow for the team
quotes.quote: It's super tough. It's tough for anybody, but we were super excited by what we'd seen. He was really active and athletic and really coachable and really engaged. We were really excited about what he could bring to the team, so that's always a bigger blow for him personally, but certainly a blow for the team, especially this early on. Seeing a guy that had a trajectory heading that way, which he'll get back to, but it just delays him for now.
quotes.social_post: Coach Nurse calls the injury to Joel Embiid a big blow for the team. He says the team was excited about his trajectory and engagement but acknowledges the setback delays his progress for now.

quotes.speaker: Coach Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Nurse on balancing veteran playing time during preseason
quotes.excerpt: I think it's such an interesting topic, not only across our sport, but I'm sure you guys follow
quotes.quote: I think it's such an interesting topic, not only across our sport, but I'm sure you guys follow the NFL a little bit and they're talking about this like crazy about these guys not playing preseason and how clunky everything looks for the first month of the year. And then guys are getting hurt anyway and they're like, wait, are they getting hurt because they didn't condition themselves? It's such an interesting topic because everybody's talking about it across multiple sports. It doesn't make much sense to me that you sit out all the games and all of a sudden it's going 100 miles an hour in game one.
quotes.social_post: Coach Nurse questions the trend of players sitting out preseason games. He says it does not make much sense to him that you sit out all the games and all of a sudden it is going 100 miles an hour in game one.

quotes.speaker: Coach Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Nurse on potential small-ball lineup candidates
quotes.excerpt: Dean would be another candidate, I think he's played some small ball five as well
quotes.quote: Dean would be another candidate, I think he's played some small ball five as well. I think that probably, we'll go with that crew unless something else emerges.
quotes.social_post: Coach Nurse identifies Dean as a candidate to play small ball five for the 76ers this season.

quotes.speaker: Coach Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Nurse on managing external noise during training camp
quotes.excerpt: all I'm really focused on is getting the players to the practice floor and getting the players
quotes.quote: All I'm really focused on is getting the players to the practice floor and getting the players to the game floor. That's what they are going to do too. We understand. We've had meetings and we've talked about, yes, there'll be outside noise, but it's up to us to manage it. I'm knee-deep in training camp, these meetings and getting every meticulous detail down to the practice schedule takes focus. Don't ask me about much that's going on in the world right now.
quotes.social_post: Coach Nurse says he is focused on training camp and managing outside noise. He tells reporters he is knee deep in training camp and to not ask him about much that is going on in the world right now.

quotes.speaker: Coach Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Nurse on how basketball IQ aids team development
quotes.excerpt: it gives you capabilities to do lots more things. All it does is speed up what you
quotes.quote: It gives you capabilities to do lots more things. All it does is speed up what you, how many times you have to cover one thing. Guys that are with more experience, with more natural IQ, even doesn't matter what age they are, that can pick things up quickly, lets you get through that checklist down the checklist further instead of having to revisit, revisit before you can actually check it off. So that always enables you again then to go maybe flip the page to another part of the menu.
quotes.social_post: Coach Nurse explains how high basketball IQ helps the team develop faster by allowing them to move through the practice checklist instead of having to revisit things.

quotes.speaker: Coach Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Nurse on his past relationship with LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I thought he was always incredibly respectful and genuinely nice to me
quotes.quote: I thought he was always incredibly respectful and genuinely nice to me. We'd always stop and talk when we played him. I didn't see him at a whole lot of events or anything like that but once in a while, nothing super extensive, but always very pleasant and engaging.
quotes.social_post: Coach Nurse reflects on his relationship with LeBron James, describing him as always incredibly respectful and genuinely nice.

quotes.speaker: Coach Nurse
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach Nurse defends Joel Embiid's work ethic
quotes.excerpt: he's been excellent. He's in great shape. He's been on the practice floor. He's worked very hard
quotes.quote: I'm just surprised by what I was told before and what you guys are asking me about because he's been excellent. He's in great shape. He's been on the practice floor. He's worked very hard and he looks really great. So it just surprises me that something like that came out right now.
quotes.social_post: Coach Nurse defends Joel Embiid amid recent criticism, stating he has been excellent and in great shape. He says he is surprised by the negative reports because the player has worked very hard.
